column1: # Rabi-Ribi on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# CreSpirit's 2D engine on NVN, SDK 7.4.0; update v131072 (display 1.2.0). Its shaders are compiled at run time by the game's own GLSLC (subsdk0): a bootstrap port saved 24 outputs
# on the device and this profile's tables were split from them. On the AYN Thor (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, Adreno 740, Android 13): boot, title, save select and gameplay, frame time
# p50 16.66 ms and no dropped frames in the 300-frame windows, the shared font set to a Pan-CJK Noto Sans, no red log line. The data pack is 0.7 GB.
